one_line_reason: A general-population single-ingredient sleep-supplement RCT arm and a pain-relief trial with an isolated l-serine dose provide real human efficacy evidence, alongside a rare-genetic-disease pediatric trial with mixed results.

selected.intervention: oral l-serine 300 mg/day, tested as its own arm alongside l-theanine, GABA, and Apocynum venetum leaf extract arms
selected.primary_outcome: sleep quality/sleep problems relative to pre-supplementation life habits and sleep conditions
selected.why_selected: The cleanest single-ingredient, dose-stated RCT arm in a general (non-clinical) population testing a mainstream marketed use (sleep support); the retrieved abstract is truncated before result values are given

selected.population: 120 adults aged 20+ with chronic low-back and knee pain (≥3 months)
selected.intervention: l-serine 594 mg plus EPA 149 mg, oral, daily for 8 weeks vs placebo
selected.primary_outcome: low-back pain (JLEQ) and knee osteoarthritis (JKOM) scores
selected.why_selected: Statistically significant pain-score improvement (P<0.001) with a clearly stated l-serine dose, though co-administered with EPA

selected.population: 4 children with GRIN2B loss-of-function variants (rare genetic neurodevelopmental disorder)
selected.intervention: oral l-serine supplementation, randomized n-of-1 trials, 2 cycles of 6 months
selected.primary_outcome: cognitive/adaptive function (PRPP-A), with secondary quality-of-life, sleep, irritability, language measures
selected.why_selected: The only shortlisted trial testing l-serine alone (no co-ingredient) with a statistically significant result on one measure, though in an ultra-rare pediatric genetic-disease population with mostly non-significant secondary outcomes

blockers: 32520991 co-administers l-serine with EPA, so the pain-relief effect cannot be attributed to l-serine alone from this trial
41265180 is in an ultra-rare pediatric genetic disorder (GRIN2B loss-of-function), not general supplement use, and most outcome measures were not statistically significant
37242260's actual result values are not present in the retrieved abstract text, so direction could not be determined from the packet alone

excluded_pmids.reason: Meta-analysis of blood/CSF serine levels in schizophrenia patients vs controls; an observational biomarker comparison, not a supplementation trial
Observational study of endogenous serum d-serine and cognitive training gains in schizophrenia; no oral l-serine was administered
Meta-analysis of peripheral blood metabolites (including L-serine) in major depressive disorder; observational biomarker study, not an intervention trial
Review of targeted therapies for hereditary peripheral neuropathies (ascorbic acid, PXT3003); l-serine is not identified as a studied therapy in the retrieved abstract
RCT of subway air-pollution exposure on lung function and serum biomarkers; l-serine is not an administered exposure, evidently a metabolite-panel retrieval artifact
RCT of exercise training on plasma lipidome in diabetes/prediabetes; l- and d-serine are measured biomarkers (found unchanged), not an administered supplement
Crossover study of THC/CBD on plasma endocannabinoid levels; no relation to l-serine supplementation apparent in the abstract

Combined Metabolic Activators (12.35 g L-serine plus nicotinamide riboside, N-acetyl-L-cysteine, and L-carnitine tartrate) in Alzheimer's disease patients; a 4-component combination in a clinical dementia population
Combined Metabolic Activators (l-serine, N-acetyl-l-cysteine, nicotinamide riboside, l-carnitine tartrate) in COVID-19 patients; combination product in an acute-infection clinical population
